headline: Tata’s £5.2 Billion UK EV Battery Factory Project Faces Construction Delay
summary: Tata Group's £5.2 billion Agratas EV battery plant in Somerset was thrown into uncertainty after its second main building contractor in five months pulled out of the project.
why: Tata Motors owns Jaguar Land Rover, relying on domestic EV battery production for long-term vehicle manufacturing.

impacts.name: Tata Motors
impacts.why: Tata's planned £5.2bn battery gigafactory lost its building contractor.
